title: SPDE models on 3D meshes
text: test basic features, construct mesh single tetrahedron: finite element structure matrices can obtained way traditional 2D triangle meshes: can extract matrices construct precision matrix manually, (1−∇⋅∇)u(s)=Ẇ(s)(1-\nabla\cdot\nabla)u(s)=\dot{W}(s): larger 3D domain, model exponential covariance function, just single tetrahedron, Neumann boundary conditions, expect see test case. new param2.matern method used construct covariance parameter prior distribution model, used new version inla.spde2.matern: internal parameterisation used param2.matern different old param2.matern.orig parameterisation, similar one used inla.spde2.pcmatern, user-visible aspects range standard deviation instead τ\tau κ\kappa. Mapping data locations works . verify mapping mesh vertices produces identity matrix:
code: mesh <- inla.mesh3d(rbind(c(0, 0, 0),                           c(1, 0, 0),                           c(0, 1, 0),                           c(0, 0, 1)),                     rbind(c(1, 2, 3, 4))) fem <- inlamesh3d::inla.mesh.fem(mesh) Q <- with(fem, c0 + 2 * g1 + g2) solve(Q) #> 4 x 4 sparse Matrix of class "dgCMatrix" #>                                          #> [1,] 6.062284 5.979239 5.979239 5.979239 #> [2,] 5.979239 6.646920 5.686920 5.686920 #> [3,] 5.979239 5.686920 6.646920 5.686920 #> [4,] 5.979239 5.686920 5.686920 6.646920 spde <- inlamesh3d::inla.spde2.matern(   mesh,   param = param2.matern(mesh,                         alpha = 2,                         prior_range = 0.1,                         prior_sigma = 1)) A <- inlamesh3d::inla.spde.make.A(mesh, mesh$loc) #> Handling: #T = 1, #loc = 4, #loc/#T = 4 #> Handled: Time/(10^3 Tetra) = 3 A #> 4 x 4 sparse Matrix of class "dgCMatrix" #>              #> [1,] 1 0 0 0 #> [2,] 0 1 0 0 #> [3,] 0 0 1 0 #> [4,] 0 0 0 1

param_estimates <- rbind(   range = exp(est$summary.hyperpar["Theta1 for field", quant]) * range0,   sigma = exp(est$summary.hyperpar["Theta2 for field", quant]) * sigma0,   obs_sigma = title: Matern SPDE model object with PC prior for INLA — inla.spde2.pcmatern
text: Create inla.spde2 model object Matern model, using PC prior parameters. method constructs Matern SPDE model, spatial range \(\rho\) standard deviation parameter \(\sigma\).  parameterisation $$(\kappa^2-\Delta)^{\alpha/2}(\tau $$$$ x(u))=W(u)$$ spatial scale parameter \(\kappa=\sqrt{8\nu}/\rho\), \(\nu=\alpha-d/2\), \(\tau\) proportional \(1/\sigma\). Stationary models supported \(0 < \alpha \leq 2\), spectral approximation methods used non-integer \(\alpha\), approximation method determined fractional.method. Integration general linear constraints supported via constr, extraconstr.int, extraconstr parameters, also interact n.iid.group.
